metadata.title: Why One Extra Atom of Distance Cuts a Tunneling Current Tenfold
metadata.thing: a microscope tip tracing a bumpy surface, the tunneling current swinging tenfold as the gap changes by one atom
metadata.color_notes: The tunnel current / wave in the gap = accent Warm Slate #5A5653. The 'tenfold' multiplier emphasis = red #C0392B. Tip, surface, gauge, brackets = ink #1a1a1a.

beats.narration_text: A scanning microscope can feel a single atom's bump on a surface.
beats.tts_normalized_text: A scanning microscope can feel a single atom's bump on a surface.
beats.new_visual_element: a person amazed at a microscope sensing one atom

beats.end_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = the person amazed, pointing at the single atom under the tip]

beats.narration_text: The trick is that moving the tip one atom farther away nearly tenths the current.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The trick is that moving the tip one atom farther away nearly tenths the current.
beats.new_visual_element: the tip lifted slightly, a current needle dropping hard
beats.start_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = a microscope tip lifted a little, with a current meter needle dropping]
beats.end_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = the tip higher, the meter needle collapsed to near zero]
beats.video_animation_prompt: the tip lifts a small amount and a current meter needle swings down hard; no hand visible, white background, napkin art doodle style
beats.negative_prompt: hand, fingers, arm, pencil, pen, marker, stylus, writing tool, shadow, paper texture, yellowing, gradient, photorealistic, 3D render, gray shading, color, brush, eraser, artifacts, distortion, camera movement, zoom, pan, wiggle, blur

beats.narration_text: A sharp tip floats a tiny gap above a bumpy row of atoms.
beats.tts_normalized_text: A sharp tip floats a tiny gap above a bumpy row of atoms.
beats.new_visual_element: a microscope tip above a bumpy atomic surface
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw a bumpy atomic surface and a sharp tip hovering a small gap above it

beats.narration_text: Electrons tunnel across the gap, giving a small current.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Electrons tunnel across the gap, giving a small current.
beats.new_visual_element: a glowing tunnel link in the gap + a current gauge
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw a glowing tunnel link from tip to surface and a current gauge with a needle on the right

beats.narration_text: That current dies exponentially with the gap — each equal step of distance divides it by ten.
beats.tts_normalized_text: That current dies exponentially with the gap — each equal step of distance divides it by ten.
beats.new_visual_element: a small ladder: gap d, 2d, 3d -> current 1, 1/10, 1/100
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: show three equal distance steps with currents 1, 1/10, 1/100 — equal steps multiply down

beats.narration_text: Now drag the tip across the surface at a fixed height.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Now drag the tip across the surface at a fixed height.
beats.new_visual_element: the tip begins tracing left to right
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: trace the tip left-to-right across the bumps at constant height; the gap shrinks over atoms and grows over valleys

beats.narration_text: Over each atom the gap narrows and the current leaps; between them it collapses.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Over each atom the gap narrows and the current leaps; between them it collapses.
beats.new_visual_element: the needle swings wildly as the tip rides the bumps
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: continue tracing; the gauge needle swings wildly between high and low as the tip rides atom to valley

beats.narration_text: A change in height too small to see becomes a tenfold change in the signal.
beats.tts_normalized_text: A change in height too small to see becomes a tenfold change in the signal.
beats.new_visual_element: tiny height bracket vs a big current swing
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: park over a bump; bracket the tiny atom-height change and contrast with the large current swing on the gauge

beats.narration_text: That brutal sensitivity is exactly what lets the microscope see single atoms.
beats.tts_normalized_text: That brutal sensitivity is exactly what lets the microscope see single atoms.
beats.new_visual_element: the traced current profile lines up with the atom positions
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: show the current peaks lining up over the atom positions — the read-out maps the atoms

beats.narration_text: One atom closer, ten times the current — that's how we photograph atoms.
beats.tts_normalized_text: One atom closer, ten times the current — that's how we photograph atoms.
beats.new_visual_element: red label 'one atom closer, ten times the current'
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: settle the picture and write a red label 'one atom closer, ten times the current'; clean close
